defaultBase.description: Default Git base revision for affected selection, overridden by an explicit base option or ISOX_BASE.

ignoreFiles.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from affected selection, taking precedence over built-in and additional global files.

globalFiles.description: Additional workspace-relative glob patterns whose changes affect every project, including shared tools owned by a project.

executors.description: Npm scopes or package names whose executors use the separately installed @isox-sh/nx plugin. Init includes @nx when the workspace root contains nx.json.
